newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Repsol, Corte Ingles set up joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol, Corte Ingles set up joint venture.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Monday it had signed an agreement to join forces with leading Spanish retailer El Corte Ingles to develop a number of high quality service stations.
Repsol said the deal included the possiblity of installing service stations and other complementary products in hypermarkets and centres belonging to or managed by El Corte Ingles.
Repsol said a new company would be created as a result of the deal in which both parties would hold 50 percent.
The company will develop a new type of service station with a much larger shop than those in Repsol's existing network.

The deal, signed on Saturday, will involve installing some 100 service stations, located in urban areas and highways. The deal does not exclude the possibility of expanding the project internationally, Repsol said.
